field.gv_theme: Dark, light or follow the system.
field.title_display: Show the Japanese title, English title or directory name in lists.
field.gv_page_size: List pages keep their own quick page-size control.
field.gv_reader_mode: The reader also keeps a quick toggle.
field.gv_reader_fit: Fit height, fit width or original size.
field.gv_slideshow_interval: Shared by the reader and the gallery page.
field.gv_online_image_mode: Direct spends no server image budget; proxy is only for devices that cannot reach H{'@'}H.
field.exhentai_base_url: e-hentai.org or exhentai.org; a custom URL must belong to one of these domains.
field.exhentai_cookie_configured: Cookie values are write-only and never echoed.
field.exhentai_cookie_names: Key names only; values are never returned.
field.ipb_member_id: Member ID from the cookie; never shown after saving. Leave blank to keep the current value.
field.ipb_pass_hash: Login hash from the cookie; never shown after saving. Leave blank to keep the current value.
field.igneous: Private-site cookie; may stay blank without private-site access.
field.http_proxy: Mutually exclusive with the SOCKS5 proxy.
field.socks5_proxy: Mutually exclusive with the HTTP proxy.
field.use_hah: Affects whether the original-image channel is reachable.
field.online_cache_max_mb: Image cache limit for the server proxy fallback; default 512.
field.gv_default_favcat: One-click card favourites use this folder.
field.gv_online_defaults: List type, toplist and minimum rating used when opening the online page.
field.library_roots: One path per line; changing this requires the current password.
field.library_root_warnings: Backend checks for the configured library roots.
field.duplicate_policy: Default policy used by the duplicates page.
field.generate_thumbnails: Create thumbnails when a gallery is indexed.
field.thumbnail_status: Result of the most recent thumbnail task.
field.download_root: Changing this requires the current password.
field.page_concurrency: Images downloaded at once per gallery, 1–16.
field.download_title: Title language used for on-disk directory names.
field.global_paused: Pauses scans and downloads; the downloads page keeps the same switch.
field.image_slow_warmup_seconds: Grace period before enforcing the minimum speed.
field.image_min_speed_kb_s: Slower images are treated as failed and retried.
field.favorites_archive_enabled: Scheduled favourite scans use the zip archive channel.
field.favorites_archive_max_pages: 0 sends everything through the archive; otherwise set the maximum pages per gallery.
field.favorites_categories: Enabled/mode/poll interval per folder live on the favourites page.
field.archive_roots: One path per line; the first entry is the effective cold storage root.
field.auto_archive_downloads: Move completed downloads to cold storage.
field.archive_delete_source: Delete the download source directory after a successful archive.
field.archive_quality: Default tier for the archive channel and the archive dialog.
field.archive_fallback_pages: Fall back to per-page downloads when archiving fails.
field.auto_sync_tags: Sync tags after a gallery is indexed.
field.translation_status: Result of the most recent translation refresh.
field.telegram_bot_configured: The token is write-only and never echoed.
field.telegram_bot_token: Leave blank to keep the current value.
field.telegram_notify_level: Summary, immediate, failures only or off.
field.auth_required: Turning this off leaves every request unauthenticated; changing it requires the current password.
field.auth_hash_configured: Whether a non-default password is set.
field.must_change_password: True while the first-run onboarding is incomplete.
field.integration_companion_script: Injects download, favourite and library-state buttons on official gallery pages; authenticates with the API token.
field.integration_comic_looms: Recommended official-page reader enhancement (MIT); this app does not ship its own script reader.
field.integration_opds_url: OPDS 1.0 catalogue with HTTP Basic auth for third-party readers.
field.thumbnail_cache_dir: Configured by the backend environment; read only.

action.ehTest: Makes one EH request with the current cookies.
action.openFavorites: Per-folder enabled, mode and poll interval are configured there.
action.purgeSources: Deletes leftover source directories of archived galleries. Irreversible.

groupHint: Only changed keys are submitted; changes apply as soon as they are saved.
copyFailed: Could not copy; select the text manually.

destructive.title: Delete source directories?
destructive.body: A successful archive deletes the source files from the download root. Make sure cold storage is backing them up first.

logout.title: Log out?
logout.body: You will need to sign in again to reach the library, online lists and settings.
